Name: Modified Maru
Author: thebigjb
Description:
[left][b][size=4]New! v2.0! [/size][/b]

==> Added glasses! <==

[b]*~*~*~*~*[b]~*~*~*~*[/b][b]~*~*~*~*

[/b][/b][i]9/5/2024 - For those concerned with violating the Geneva Convention, I added an optional version with the original blue cross on her uniform. [/i][/left]

[b]Requires v1.6+[/b]

Thanks for checking out this mod!

By popular request, I made the following improvements to our favorite science genius girl:

[list=1]
[*]Removes her bowlegs in both seasonal outfits.
[*]Removes her bowlegs in her hospital uniform.
[*]Made the cross on her hat red.
[*]Added glasses.
[/list]
Her beach appearance should be unchanged.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]
SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ are required. Download the file then unzip/extract it into into your Stardew mods folder!

Need help getting started with mods? Not sure where your mods folder lives? Check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]this handy guide[/url] to get the ball rolling.

Be sure to check out all of my mods:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21721]Amended Abigail[/url]﻿ - removes her hair bow, bowlegs, and matches eye color to her portrait.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22255]Goodbye Goofy Gus[/url] - removes his open mouth and pursed lips.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23094]Handsomer Harvey[/url]﻿ - adds moustache, updates hairstyle, fixes "chicken legs" at the beach, gives him chest hair at the beach
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22878]Jazzed-up Jodi[/url]﻿ - removes bowlegs from all seasons plus two options for slimming down her summer appearance or not.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22874/]Leveled-up Leah[/url]﻿ - removes her bowlegs and adds a knee crick when painting.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22523]Modified Maru[/url] - removes bowlegs, [u]adds glasses[/u], and makes uniform's cross red.﻿
[/list]
